note: Phase-2 screen, Inkling-2-Mini @b85c3cf (NVFP4 experts L0-19, MXFP8 L20-23, rest BF16). Vendor Balanced recipe at TP1, no speculation, text-only (no --enable-multimodal / image limit 0), context 32768. Then OpenRelay's prefill probe and column A (vllm bench serve, random tokens) and column B (traffic.py real text, tokenizer-exact, stratified) at multiples of break-even vs the PrimeIntellect bar ($0.0008265/req), seed 7, 120 s rungs (screen only).
